mechanics.normalIngredient: Normal ingredient nutrition fraction uses recipe use × (1 - 0.03 × Cooking) divided by the source getHungChange, capped at 1; transferred calories/macros are then multiplied by (1 + Cooking/15).
mechanics.spice: Spices do not add normal dish hunger; they can add nutrition, use the same Cooking nutrition multiplier, and cannot be duplicated.
mechanics.rotten: Rotten evolved ingredients require Cooking 7+. At Cooking 7-8 the requested use is based on 5% of base hunger; at 9-10 it is 10%.
mechanics.frozen: Supplied B42.20 evolved recipes do not set AllowFrozenItem, so frozen source foods are rejected.
mechanics.burnt: Burnt source foods are rejected from evolved-recipe additions.
mechanics.base: When an evolved result is created, Food bases pass their hunger/macros/thirst into the result. Non-food container bases start those values at zero.
mechanics.Fluid nutrition: Standalone fluid rows are normalized to 1 L from B42.20 fluid Properties. Pre-filled fluid-container items use their actual container capacity; random-fluid containers display min–max ranges instead of a fabricated single value.
mechanics.cookedSource: For a cooked normal ingredient, the nutrition fraction is calculated first; the hunger actually removed from the source is then divided by 1.3. This stretches cooked ingredients without adding a second macro multiplier.
mechanics.finalCooking: For cookable evolved dishes, cooking the assembled result makes effective hunger relief ×1.3 while Calories, Carbs, Fat, and Protein stay unchanged. Normal successful completion adds 10 Cooking XP.
